<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head></head><body>
<img id="img" src="logo.png">
<canvas id="cvs" width="244" height="244"></canvas>
<script>
window.onload = function() {
    var img = document.getElementById('img');
    var w = img.naturalWidth;
    var h = img.naturalHeight;

    var cvs = document.getElementById('cvs');
    cvs.width = w;
    cvs.height = h;
    var ctx = cvs.getContext('2d');
    ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);

    var imgData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h);
    var data = imgData.data;

    // Detect background color from corners
    var bgR = data[0], bgG = data[1], bgB = data[2];

    // Create transparent version with Gold Emblem
    // First, let's create a canvas for the Gold version
    var goldCvs = document.createElement('canvas');
    goldCvs.width = w;
    goldCvs.height = h;
    var gCtx = goldCvs.getContext('2d');

    // Create linear gradient for gold
    var grad = gCtx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, w, h);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#FFFBE6');
    grad.addColorStop(0.3, '#F5D061');
    grad.addColorStop(0.7, '#D4AF37');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#997300');

    // Process mask: calculate distance from background color
    var maskData = gCtx.createImageData(w, h);
    var mData = maskData.data;

    for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
        var r = data[i], g = data[i+1], b = data[i+2], a = data[i+3];
        // Calculate difference from background (deep blue ~ 9, 1, 172)
        var diff = Math.sqrt((r - bgR)*(r - bgR) + (g - bgG)*(g - bgG) + (b - bgB)*(b - bgB));
        
        // Also check if brightness is significantly higher than dark blue
        var brightness = (r * 0.299 + g * 0.587 + b * 0.114);
        var bgBrightness = (bgR * 0.299 + bgG * 0.587 + bgB * 0.114);
        var bDiff = brightness - bgBrightness;

        var alpha = 0;
        if (diff > 45 || bDiff > 25) {
            // Smooth edge transition (anti-aliasing)
            alpha = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, (diff - 30) * 4));
        }

        mData[i] = 255;
        mData[i+1] = 255;
        mData[i+2] = 255;
        mData[i+3] = alpha;
    }

    // Draw the gold gradient filled on goldCvs
    gCtx.fillStyle = grad;
    gCtx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

    // Apply the mask using destination-in
    var tempCvs = document.createElement('canvas');
    tempCvs.width = w;
    tempCvs.height = h;
    var tCtx = tempCvs.getContext('2d');
    tCtx.putImageData(maskData, 0, 0);

    gCtx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';
    gCtx.drawImage(tempCvs, 0, 0);

    // Add subtle gold glow
    var finalCvs = document.createElement('canvas');
    finalCvs.width = w;
    finalCvs.height = h;
    var fCtx = finalCvs.getContext('2d');
    fCtx.shadowColor = 'rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.6)';
    fCtx.shadowBlur = 8;
    fCtx.drawImage(goldCvs, 0, 0);

    var goldPng = finalCvs.toDataURL('image/png');

    // Also create a pure clean white/platinum version
    var whiteCvs = document.createElement('canvas');
    whiteCvs.width = w;
    whiteCvs.height = h;
    var wCtx = whiteCvs.getContext('2d');
    wCtx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
    wCtx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    wCtx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';
    wCtx.drawImage(tempCvs, 0, 0);
    var whitePng = whiteCvs.toDataURL('image/png');

    var p = document.createElement('p');
    p.id = "result";
    p.innerText = goldPng + ":::" + whitePng;
    document.body.appendChild(p);
};
</script>


<p id="result">data:image/png;base64,:::data:image/png;base64,</p></body></html>
